title: Enhanced desulfurization performance of model fuel by Cu–ZnO/TiO2 heterostructure
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,36733-36744
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06833E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jiaxin Xu, Yongjie Zheng, Jingzhi Tian, Yunpeng Zhao, Heshan Zheng
A Cu/ZnO–TiO2 composite photocatalyst with a Z-type heterojunction was prepared by homogeneous grafting of ZnO nanoneedles onto the TiO2 surface by the hydrothermal method. The degradation rate of the target contaminant was 88.12%.
